rationale: A unanimous, text-driven holding turns on § 1415(l)'s remedial trigger—exhaustion is required only when the plaintiff seeks relief also available under IDEA—making Justice Kagan or Justice Barrett especially plausible authors for a clean statutory opinion. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Alito/Thomas/Gorsuch (artful-pleading and separation-of-powers cautions) or Justice Barrett (to cabin Fry/gravamen and emphasize the damages-only posture).
